化.meaning: to take the form of (esp. in ref. to a spirit, fox, raccoon dog, etc.)

取.meaning: gathering material (for an article, novel, etc.)

受.meaning: taking an examination (esp. for entrance to a school or university)

産.meaning: first cry of a newborn baby

活.meaning: sashimi prepared from live fish, arranged in its original shape

任.meaning: to leave (a matter, decision, etc. to someone)

論.meaning: conclusion (of an argument, discussion, study, etc.)

局.meaning: court lady with her own private chamber or office

与.meaning: to give (esp. to someone of lower status)

席.meaning: seat (esp. in public places or places with assigned seating)

乗.meaning: to get on (train, plane, bus, ship, etc.)

候.meaning: lodger who pays nothing for room and board

単.meaning: twelve-layered ceremonial kimono (worn by a court lady)

座.meaning: seat (esp. in public places or places with assigned seating)

彼.meaning: equinoctial week (when Buddhist services are held)

舞.meaning: stage (of a theatre, concert hall, etc.)
visit (to someone affected by illness or misfortune)

適.meaning: to suit (one's needs, tastes, purpose, etc.)

留.meaning: to bring down (an animal, opponent, etc.)

更.meaning: now (when it is already much too late)

抱.meaning: to hold in one's arms (e.g. a baby)

恥.meaning: great shame (endured in the public eye)

猫.meaning: cat (esp. the domestic cat, Felis catus)
